fields.workflowName: WA Order to Sheet to Razorpay link (n8n, prod)
fields.whatItAutomates: Triggered by a message into the business WhatsApp number. n8n parses the order line (item, quantity, society name), appends a row to the Orders sheet with the delivery slot, then creates a Razorpay payment link for the amount and sends it back on the same chat within about eight seconds. Before this I was making links by hand in the dashboard and typing them out, roughly 6-8 minutes per order in the evening rush. It has been running on real customer orders since 29 Aug, no manual triggers.

notes: Expected pass on the tracker's run count alone - workflowTenRuns is true at 14 real runs. This checkpoint is NOT reviewed by a model; the two fields only label the workflow on the spine. The case exists to prove the harness skips the reviewer entirely and reads the signal.
